app.name: SheOra
app.tagline: Private tracking, gentle insights, doctor-ready reports
app.disclaimer: This is an estimate for personal tracking, not medical advice or contraception.

welcome.title: Welcome to SheOra
welcome.subtitle: Your private, calm companion for understanding your body on your terms.
welcome.hasAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
welcome.ageGateNotice: Designed for women aged 18-35 in India.

onboarding.step1Subtitle: You can change this anytime in settings.
onboarding.step2Subtitle: SheOra is designed exclusively for adult privacy and autonomy.
onboarding.ageConfirmation: I confirm that I am 18 years of age or older
onboarding.under18Message: SheOra is crafted for individuals 18 years and older. For users under 18, we require guardian guidance and do not store any personal data. Please consult your family physician or trusted guardian for any health guidance.
onboarding.step3Subtitle: Explicit consent is required for each item. Nothing is pre-checked.
onboarding.consentTerms: I agree to the Terms of Service (Draft: requires legal review).
onboarding.consentPrivacy: I understand and accept the Privacy Policy explaining zero third-party sharing.
onboarding.consentHealthData: I give explicit consent to securely store my sensitive cycle and symptom entries.
onboarding.consentLocalStorage: I allow local offline caching so I can access my saved articles and reports without internet.
onboarding.step4Subtitle: Choose your primary focus. We will tailor your gentle insights.
onboarding.goalConceive: Track cycle window while planning pregnancy
onboarding.step5Subtitle: If you are unsure, feel free to choose 'I don't know'.
onboarding.lastPeriodLabel: First day of your last period

home.irregularNote: Because your cycle varies, this estimate has a wider gentle range.
home.checkinDone: You have checked in for today! Edit anytime.

calendar.title: Cycle Calendar
calendar.historyEmpty: No past cycles logged yet. They will appear here automatically.

checkin.title: Daily Quick Check-in
checkin.subtitle: Takes less than 30 seconds. Log how your body feels today.
checkin.notesPlaceholder: Any notes for yourself or questions for your doctor...

symptoms.title: Symptom Tracker
symptoms.subtitle: Track how strong symptoms feel on a 0 to 10 scale.
symptoms.timelineEmpty: No symptoms recorded yet for this timeframe.

insights.title: Cycle Insights
insights.subtitle: Gentle, non-diagnostic observations from your logged data.
insights.disclaimer: This is an estimate for personal tracking, not medical advice. SheOra never provides automated diagnoses.
insights.emptyMessage: Please log at least 2 full cycles so SheOra can observe your personal baseline and provide meaningful trend charts.
insights.patternNotice: Pattern worth discussing with your doctor
insights.patternExplanation: If you observe persistent pelvic discomfort or cycles longer than 38 days over multiple months, consider carrying your Doctor Report to a registered gynecologist.

library.title: Ask Her — Health Library
library.subtitle: Compassionate, plain-language education written for Indian women.

report.title: Doctor-Ready Report
report.subtitle: Generate a concise, dignified 1-2 page health summary to share directly with your healthcare provider.
report.disclaimer: Notice for Medical Providers: This summary is generated from personal patient self-reporting via SheOra. It is not an automated diagnosis or clinical assessment.

settings.title: Privacy & Security
settings.subtitle: You are in complete control of your data and identity.
settings.discreetDesc: Changes the app name to 'S-Notes' and neutralizes notification wording for quiet privacy.
settings.lowDataDesc: Loads lightweight vector icons, pauses animations, and optimizes data usage for low-connectivity areas.
settings.pinDesc: Requires a 4-digit PIN every time you reopen SheOra.
settings.exportDesc: Download a complete copy of every entry you have ever made.
settings.withdrawDesc: Permanently erase your account and all associated cycles, logs, and symptoms from servers and device.
settings.deleteConfirmMsg: This action cannot be undone. All cycle logs, symptoms, check-ins, and saved articles will be permanently removed.
settings.termsOfService: Terms of Service (Draft: requires legal review)

redFlag.title: Health Notice: Immediate Care Recommended
redFlag.heavyBleedingAlert: You logged very heavy bleeding. If you are soaking through one or more pads/tampons every hour for 2 consecutive hours, passing large blood clots, or feeling dizzy, please seek immediate medical evaluation.
redFlag.severePainAlert: You recorded high pain intensity (8+ / 10). Sudden or debilitating pain that doesn't ease with standard care warrants prompt medical attention.
redFlag.mentalDistressAlert: If you are experiencing severe emotional distress or thoughts of self-harm, please reach out to dedicated compassionate helplines immediately.
